market.title: Market
market.emptyWatch: You’re not following any asset yet. Search for one or tap «All».
market.stale: Some prices are a few minutes behind. Reconnecting to the provider…
market.dataNote: Real prices: US stocks and crypto live; Spanish stocks, Xetra and the IBEX delayed by 15 min. Currencies live.
market.noPosition: You don't own {name} yet. You can start small: €50 already buys you a fraction.
market.indexNote: You can't buy an index directly: you follow it to understand the market. To invest in it you use an ETF.
market.limitBuyHelp: Buys if the price drops to this level.
market.limitSellHelp: Sells if the price rises to this level.
market.stopHelp: Sells if the price drops to this level: it limits the loss.
market.tpHelp: Sells if the price rises to this level: it locks in the gain.
market.lockedNote: Limit, stop loss and take profit unlock with the «The stop loss» lesson or with the Max plan.
market.closedNote: The market is closed: the order will stay pending and run when it opens.

errors.INSUFFICIENT_QTY: You don't hold that many units
errors.BAD_STOP: The stop loss must be below the price
errors.BAD_TAKE_PROFIT: The take profit must be above the price

market.riskHead: Hold on, {name}. That's a lot in a single asset.
market.riskBody: With this purchase, {name} would be {pct} % of your portfolio. If it falls 10 %, you'd lose about {loss}. Spreading across several assets softens that blow.
market.lockBody: Limit, stop loss and take profit orders unlock when you pass the «The stop loss» lesson (Unit 6 · Orders, free) or with the Max plan. That way you first understand what they are for.
market.pendingMarket: The market is closed. Your order will run when it opens ({when}), at that moment's price.
market.pendingTrigger: It will run when the price reaches {price}.
market.alertNote: We'll let you know in the app when it happens. Just once.
market.noPositions: You don't have any positions yet.
market.noAlerts: You have no alerts. Create them from an asset page.
market.searchGlobal: Search almost 4,000 assets: Apple, Santander, Bitcoin, gold…
market.resultsCount: {n, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}}

typeHint.STOCK: 3,600: US, Europe, Asia and Latin America

market.dataNoteGlobal: Real prices from Yahoo Finance. US, crypto and FX near real time; Europe 15 min delayed, Asia 15–20 min. Commodities: futures, 10 min delayed.
market.lossAtStop: If it triggers, you’d lose about {amount}
market.gainAtTarget: If it’s reached, you’d gain about {amount}
market.exitsNote: They’re created when the buy fills. If one triggers, the other is cancelled.
market.favHint: Tap ☆ Follow on any asset to keep it here.

streak.title: Streak
streak.atRisk: Your {n}-day streak is at risk. A 5-minute lesson is enough.

league.title: {name} League
league.rule: Points = this week's XP + risk-adjusted return. Betting everything on one trade doesn't earn you more.
league.joinHint: Earn your first XP of the week (a lesson or a trade) and you will join a group of up to 30 people in your division.

admin.settingsNote: In stage 3 these values are stored in the Settings table and can be edited here; every change is logged in the audit.

tutor.title: Ask {name}

modeHint.EXPLAIN: Ask about any course concept: she explains it with examples.
modeHint.PATH: Recommends your next step based on your progress.
modeHint.PORTFOLIO: Reviews your simulated positions and trades using what the course teaches. Plus or Max.

tutor.intro: Your course tutor. Ask me anything you don’t understand: I answer with the E-Trading manual and your progress. I don’t give investment advice: I teach you to decide for yourself.

suggest.s2: How do I read a candle?

tutor.limitPremium: You’ve reached today’s limit. More tomorrow.

tutor.engineLumi: Lumi answers from the course, no external AI

lumi.title: Your {name}
lumi.story: Lumi is a jelly cube that keeps you company in E-Trading. It explains what you don’t understand, warns you before a bad trade and reminds you of your plan when the market gets nervous. The more you learn, the more it glows: little bubbles of light appear inside.
lumi.max: Lumi is glowing at full power. Well done.
